items.text: `dotenv get` in `src/dotenv/cli.py` has a `--default` option (added 2026-11-04 on branch `feature/get-default`, uncommitted): if the key is missing or bare (e.g. `a` with no `=`), it prints the default and exits 0. A key set to an empty string still prints an empty line and ignores the default; `--default ""` on a missing key prints an empty line and exits 0. A missing or unreadable `.env` file still exits 2, deliberately unchanged because it is a file error, not a missing key. Five tests in `tests/test_cli.py` cover missing key, bare key, existing value, empty-string value, and empty default.

`dotenv run` was switched to `os.execvpe` (#523, released in 1.1.0 on 2025-03-25), replacing the dotenv process with the user's command instead of keeping a `subprocess.Popen` parent. This avoids a lingering parent process consuming RAM and lets signals such as SIGTERM reach the command directly, which matters in Docker and containers. The child's exit-code behaviour is preserved. The change was later found problematic on Windows and fixed in 1.1.1 (#566).

items.text: `load_dotenv` and `dotenv_values` accept any text stream (`IO[str]`) as `stream`, e.g. `open("foo", "r")` (July 14, 2021).

Core loading and parsing correctness fixes in 2018: only previously defined variables are used for interpolation, fixing empty self-referential variables (#135, ref #132); `export ` prefix stripped via partition instead of lstrip (#125); `.env` being a directory no longer raises IOError thanks to os.path.isfile (#120); loading from the current directory fixed (#109); `set_key` adds a newline when updating (#123); environment variables forced to str on Python 2 Windows (#101).

Test conventions (2020-01-22): tests are placed in the matching test file, check logged warnings, avoid duplicating lower-level checks, and follow the Arrange/Act/Assert pattern, for clearer tests and easier failure interpretation.

set_key round-trips backslashes (#680, fixes #661, 2026-08-16): it escapes backslashes before single quotes when writing, and both single- and double-quoted parser patterns treat a backslash as escaping whatever follows. Previously values like C:\Users were read back wrong, and a value ending in a backslash broke parsing of following entries.

The `get` and `list` CLI commands have improved error messages (Nov 2022), e.g. `dotenv -f . list` prints 'Error opening env file: [Errno 21] Is a directory' instead of a confusing message; I/O was refactored to reduce system calls and race conditions.
Reading .env from FIFOs is supported on Unix (#586), with FileNotFoundError handled in FIFO checks. The gh-pages docs deployment uses peaceiris/actions-gh-pages (fixed 2025-10-26).

items.text: Variable expansion was reworked (November 15, 2020): parsing and expansion were decoupled into two steps (parse into atoms, then resolve), and expansion order without override was fixed so e.g. `URL=http://localhost:${PORT}` resolves consistently; `load_dotenv` always assumes override=True.

Type hints were added and exposed to users in 2019-03 (a25c419), with the `typing` dependency restricted to Python < 3.5 (b6fd94e). An encoding argument for .env files was also added, defaulting to None (c50c6f7).

The `set` CLI command gained an `--export` option (2020) that prepends `export` to the binding, and now creates `.env` in the current directory if none is found. `set_key` now escapes values before quoting (#236).

Parser fix (#663, fixes #600, 2026-06-17): an unquoted empty value followed by an inline comment (`KEY= # comment`) is now parsed as an empty string; previously the equal-sign regex consumed whitespace after `=` so the comment became the value. Values without a space before `#` (`KEY=#novalue`, `KEY=a#b`) are unchanged.

Release 1.0.0 (2023-02-24) dropped Python 3.7 support and added Python 3.12-dev/alpha (#449), after earlier robustness work: gracefully handling code imported from a zipfile (#456) and handling a nonexistent cwd (#446, seen with dynaconf).

Docs improvements: Reference page readability improved using mkdocstrings recommended settings (function name headings, table of contents, removed source code) (#605); README 'Related projects' cleaned up (removed archived django-environ-2, updated dynaconf URL) (#602); README clarified what load_dotenv() does (#575); license specifier fixed to table format (#597). | When: 2026-01-12 | Involving: Bertrand Bonnefoy-Claudet, cpackham-atlnz, Tomiwa Kunle Oluwadare | Readability and fix pip license warning

`set_key` quoting was improved (May 29, 2021; October 23, 2021): `quote_mode` must be `auto`, `never` or `always`; surrounding quotes are no longer stripped; single quotes are used instead of double to avoid interpretation by the parser/Bash; `auto` was restored to skip quoting alphanumeric values. A fix also adds a missing trailing newline when appending a new value to a file lacking one.

Variable interpolation evolved in 2020: control over interpolation was added (v0.11.0), Bash-like default values in expansion were added (v0.13.0), and v0.14.0 fixed interpolation order and a duplicate-key expansion bug (bindings were deduped into a dict before interpolation, yielding empty values).

Packaging and CI restructuring (2018-11-15): the `dotenv` package moved into a `src` directory so tests run against the installed version; tox added to run the suite across Python versions with coverage and flake8; Travis CI switched to tox; Python 3.7 added to the test suite.

Release 1.2.4 (2026-10-01; notes cover #663, #698, #700) included: `dotenv get` exits 0 for empty string values (#700, fixes #699); --no-override honored when expanding variables in `dotenv run` (#698, fixes #697); test_run_with_command_flags made portable (#709, fixes #708); SPDX string used for project.license to silence the build deprecation warning (#648).

Release 1.0.1 was prepared on 2024-01-23 (version bump 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1, changelog), with Python 3.12 and pypy3.10 added to the test runner. Fixes: the rewrite function no longer deletes the temp file before closing it, which errored on Windows because it cannot unlink open files (#468); modules using load_dotenv can be reloaded when launched in a separate thread via updated `is_interactive` code (#497).

BREAKING change (#607, 2026-01-12): `dotenv run` now forwards flags after the command to that command instead of interpreting them. Flags for run go right after `run` (`dotenv run --override ls`); generic options go after `dotenv` (`dotenv --file path/to/env run ls`).

items.text: The default `encoding` for `load_dotenv` and `dotenv_values` changed to "utf-8" (March 10, 2021), superseding the earlier None/locale-based default introduced in 2019. This is breaking only for non-UTF-8 locale users with non-UTF-8 .env files. Rationale: .env encoding should not depend on locale; Flask and Docker Compose already enforce utf-8. An `encoding` parameter was later added to `get_key`, `set_key`, `unset_key` for consistency (February 19, 2022).

Test suite isolation convention (#160): tests use the `dotenv_file` and `tmp_path` fixtures (preferred over `tmpdir`, which relies on maintenance-mode `py.path`) so each test gets a unique, cleaned-up directory. This fixed leftover files from failing tests, forgotten cleanup (#153) and unsafe parallel runs; an earlier commit (cf9bd1f) removed temp files created by CLI tests.

The project switched from the `warnings` module to `logging` for runtime issues (2019-11-03), because warnings show library source code to users and are meant for programming issues like deprecation, and are noisy in tests. Testing needed `mock` for Python 2 compatibility at that time.

File-writing error handling fixes (Sept-Oct 2026): rewrite() no longer leaves a .tmp_* file behind or masks the original write error when cleanup fails on Windows with a read-only .env (#686); set_key and unset_key write errors now name the .env path (#711, fixes #710). This builds on earlier rewrite error-handling fixes such as #413 and #468.

CI and repo hygiene in early 2024: the multiline string in test.yml was fixed and a fail-fast strategy set (#514); Dependabot was enabled to keep GitHub Actions up to date; a SECURITY policy with a contact email was added, modeled on GitHub's example and the Pallets project.

Python 3.14 was added to GitHub CI and tox.ini (#579) along with the missing 3.14 PyPI classifier, and CI testing on free-threaded Python 3.14t was enabled later (#588), between Oct 2025 and Jan 2026.

Typing was tightened in June-July 2021: Python 3 type hints for functions, mypy 'untyped defs' checking enabled (fixing `set_key`/`unset_key` `dotenv_path` typing), and Mypy 0.900+ support with `types-mock` stubs. CI Mypy failures were fixed because new Mypy needs type packages even with `ignore_missing_imports`.

Fixed parsing of variables without a value (#158, fixes #157): `\s` in the equal-sign matcher consumed newlines, so `FOO=\nBAR=b` parsed as `[("FOO","BAR=b")]` instead of FOO empty and BAR=b. Released as 0.10.1 on 2018-12-14.

Parser robustness fixes (2019-11 to 2020-09): malformed lines print a warning on stderr while parsing continues; Binding gained an `error` field so comment-only lines are not flagged as malformed (v0.10.4/0.10.5); keys without values are supported; unquoted values with two or more spaces or tabs parse correctly (2020-09-09); no warning for an empty last line.

A leading ~ is expanded to the user's home directory consistently across the API, CLI and IPython magic: #615 added it to load_dotenv, dotenv_values, get_key, set_key, unset_key and the CLI --file option (fixes #525); #714 extended it to find_dotenv and the IPython %dotenv magic (Sept-Oct 2026).

Parser overhaul in python-dotenv 0.10.0 (commit d33366c, #148, 2018-12-05): parsing no longer line-based (`parse_line` replaced by `parse_binding`), parsing code deduplicated, `get_stream` turned into a context manager. Added support for multiline values (fixes #89), backslashes in values (#112), trailing comments (#141), and unquoted UTF-8 values (#147). Supersedes #142; regex inspired by Ruby bkeepers/dotenv; also fixed W605 warnings. Later refactored into a handwritten top-down parser (#180).

The parser was refactored (#180, 2019-05-22) from a single large regex into a handwritten top-down parser in a separate module using smaller regexes, because one regex could not satisfy the requirements. It fixed inconsistencies after 0.10.0: escapes were interpreted in single-quoted strings, and '#' was treated as a comment start without preceding whitespace. Escapes in double-quoted strings are kept.

python-dotenv dropped Python 2 support and requires Python >= 3.5 (commit fbc7a63, June-July 2021), a big change enabling simplification, more features, better robustness and easier contributions. Follow-up cleanups removed Python 2-specific code (`to_env`/`to_text` identity functions), 'coding: utf-8' declarations, unnecessary future imports and typing guards, and replaced `Text` with `str`.
Parser recovery handles invalid lines with CRLF line endings; tests ensure correct line numbers are reported after CRLF parser recovery (#669, 2026-10-28).

CI also runs tests on Windows using the lowest and highest supported Python versions, to protect Windows-specific code (e.g. upcoming `dotenv run` error handling) from regressions with minimally intrusive changes. Tests that need Unix-only `sh` or case-sensitive environment variables are disabled on Windows, and platform checks use `sys.platform == "win32"`.

items.text: Proposal to change `dotenv run` CLI to use `os.execvpe` instead of `subprocess.Popen`, replacing the dotenv process with the user's command so no parent process lingers. Benefits: no hanging parent consuming RAM, and signals like SIGTERM reach the command directly (important in Docker/containers); existing behaviour (propagating the child exit code) is preserved. | Involving: @eekstunt | Reduces resource use and improves signal handling and reliability for production and containerized deployments
